findings.title: Upsampling check uses outer dataset instead of scoped_dataset
findings.body: `is_errors_query_for_error_upsampled_projects` is passed the outer `dataset` instead of `scoped_dataset`. During the dashboard split flow, `_get_event_stats` is called with `discover` for errors-only queries and with the original dataset for other queries. The upsampling decision is still made from the request's top-level dataset. As a result, upsampling can be applied to the wrong dataset, or skipped for the error split queries.

findings.title: Eligibility cache defeats allowlist changes, and the invalidation helper is never called
findings.body: The allowlist result is cached for 60 seconds. `invalidate_upsampling_cache` is never called anywhere, so allowlist changes take up to 60 seconds to apply. The docstring of `_are_all_projects_error_upsampled` says the configuration is read fresh each time, which the cache contradicts. Separately, the comment justifies the cache as avoiding an expensive option lookup, but `options.get` is already cached locally, so the extra cache round-trip likely makes things slower, not faster.

findings.title: Python hash() in shared cache key
findings.body: The cache key embeds `hash(tuple(...))` and is stored in a shared cache. Hashing a tuple of ints is stable across processes today, but it can collide, and two different project sets that collide would read each other's eligibility result. Use a deterministic join of the sorted IDs or a digest such as md5 instead.

findings.title: Substring match for event.type:error is unreliable
findings.body: `_is_error_focused_query` checks whether `event.type:error` appears anywhere in the lowercased query string. It therefore matches negated queries such as `!event.type:error`, and queries with OR clauses that also include transactions. In those cases `sum(sample_weight)` runs over transaction rows, where the column doesn't exist or is null, producing wrong counts or query failures.

findings.title: sum(sample_weight) undercounts events lacking a weight
findings.body: `upsampled_count` sums `sample_weight` and assumes every event in an allowlisted project has one. Events with a null weight, such as those ingested before sampling was enabled, contribute 0 instead of 1. Wrapping the column as `ifNull(sample_weight, 1)` would count them correctly.

findings.title: Accidental submodule committed
findings.body: A gitlink named `sentry-repo` pointing at the base commit has been added to the repository. It appears to be an accidental commit with no purpose in this change, and it will break clones and CI for anyone who initializes submodules. Remove it.

findings.title: Trailing whitespace and misleading comments
findings.body: Lines 223, 234 and 278 contain trailing whitespace, which lint will flag. The comments describing the check as a "cached result" and a "late transformation" for "query optimization" are inaccurate: the check simply runs on every call, and the transformation is the same in every branch.
